mapper.select: SELECT distinct S_BDGORGCODE as id, S_BDGORGNAME as name FROM edw.cm_guoku_bdgorg where 1=1
SELECT distinct AgentBankNo as id, AgentBankName as name FROM edw.cm_guoku_AgentBankClass where 1=1

SELECT distinct a.GUOKU_ID id, a.GUOKU_DSCR name, CASE WHEN LEVEL = 3 THEN a.GUOKU_LVL_ID_1 WHEN LEVEL = 4 THEN a.GUOKU_LVL_ID_2 WHEN LEVEL = 5 THEN a.GUOKU_LVL_ID_3 ELSE a.guoku_id END pid FROM edw.cm_guoku_dimnsn a where 1=1
AND ( a.GUOKU_ID = #{params.guoku_id} OR a.GUOKU_LVL_ID_3 = #{params.guoku_id} )
AND ( a.OLD_GUOKU_ID = #{params.OLD_GUOKU_ID} OR a.GUOKU_ID = #{params.OLD_GUOKU_ID} )

SELECT distinct SUBJECT_code_4 id, SUBJECT_DSCR_4 name, CASE WHEN LEVEL = 0 THEN 0 WHEN LEVEL = 1 THEN SUBJECT_code_1 WHEN LEVEL = 2 THEN SUBJECT_code_1 WHEN LEVEL = 3 THEN SUBJECT_code_2 WHEN LEVEL = 4 THEN SUBJECT_code_3 END pId, LEVEL FROM edw.cm_guoku_rcpt_dsb WHERE 1=1 AND SUBJECT_CODE_0 = 2 AND STATE=0 ORDER BY id

SELECT distinct SUBJECT_code_4 id, SUBJECT_code_4 name, CASE WHEN LEVEL = 0 THEN 0 WHEN LEVEL = 1 THEN SUBJECT_code_1 WHEN LEVEL = 2 THEN SUBJECT_code_1 WHEN LEVEL = 3 THEN SUBJECT_code_2 WHEN LEVEL = 4 THEN SUBJECT_code_3 END pId, LEVEL FROM edw.cm_guoku_rcpt_dsb WHERE 1=1 AND SUBJECT_CODE_0 = 2 AND STATE=0 ORDER BY id
